text.instruction: Answer the question using only the context. Return only the shortest answer span. If the context does not contain an answer, return exactly <No Answer>.

image.instruction: Identify the main object shown in the image. Return its most specific ImageNet object class name only, without an article or explanation.

ocr.instruction: Transcribe every printed word and number on this entire receipt from top to bottom. Output one text line per printed text line, using single spaces between words. Copy punctuation that belongs to words, numbers and prices. Do not draw tables, ruled separator lines, padding or repeated alignment characters. Do not omit headers, footers, addresses, totals or item details. Return the transcription only, without any explanation.
ocr.format_policy: plain visible text with declared HTML/Markdown normalization; no guessed YAML removal

common_input_preparation.reason: fixed CPU and visual input budget before model output comparison

asr.instruction: Transcribe the English speech verbatim. Return the transcription only, without timestamps, speaker labels, translation or explanations.

quality_gate.scope: Research service minima chosen before new-model outputs; not business SLOs

notes: Inputs, decoding, scoring, quality gates and utility reference scales frozen before compact model outputs; GPU validation pending.
Native input formatting may differ; all models receive the same underlying task input and label catalog.
No artificial work, skipped input modalities, or hidden text/audio truncation.

GPU smoke revision: all three generative classifiers use the same complete 1000-label token trie; no reference labels enter decoding; incorrect legal classes remain incorrect. Frozen before independent quality evaluation.

R4 calibration-only repair: declared no-repeat 35-token ngram control for every OCR/ASR candidate. DeepSeek eval already used 35 natively. Budgets, complete inputs, EOS requirements, quality minima, superiority tests and utility unchanged. Not a claim of acceptable transcription quality.

R4 calibration-only interface repair: all 1000 exact canonical class names remain available; duplicate names use their WordNet IDs as explicit disambiguators. Exact reversible name-to-ID lookup; no gold labels, fuzzy matching, candidate pruning or changed top-1 metric. Optional QA normalization only maps a complete No Answer marker with optional brackets and terminal punctuation.

R5 calibration repair: complete 1000-class canonical-name trie remains sample-independent; catalog presentation is decoder-only rather than a 13000-token catalog in the prompt. Full original image bytes and every possible class remain present.

R5 explicitly changes decoding: OCR repetition penalty 1.1; ASR 1.2 (also the pinned MiniCPM deterministic-chat default). No-repeat remains 35, and EOS/output budgets/timeouts remain unchanged. Accuracy effects require fresh evaluation.

OCR instructions request every visible word and number without drawing alignment characters; outputs are scored unchanged by the existing punctuation-preserving CER metric. No prediction-dependent cleanup.
Repair probes use the full frozen calibration cohorts, never the independent evaluation outputs. No prior success receipts are inherited.
Repair release: native MiniCPM ASR beam3 and native DeepSeek Free OCR restored. Classification calibration remains rejected; no model-pool or system admission.
